subject: Marketplace renewal synchronization — acceptance window, invoice phasing & interim capacity patch
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@helix.ai>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-pay@helix.ai
Date: 2026-08-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace renewal & short-term capacity request

Hi Mateo,

We're close to signing the renewal for Helix's marketplace private offer, but procurement needs clarity on two items before we can route the PO:

1) Acceptance window/milestone schedule for the marketplace private offer — finance needs to align the invoice phasing with our quarterly close (we'd prefer invoice tranches).
2) We have an immediate spike in inference usage next month (model evaluation run). Can Redwood provide a 30-day interim capacity uplift (burst) while the private-offer paperwork is processed?

If a short-term paid burst is possible, please send pricing and whether you'd invoice immediately or add to the first PO tranche. Also attach any private-offer checklist so our Sourcing team knows required fields.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Platform Engineering, Helix AI
S: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: none
From: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@helix.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace renewal & short-term capacity request

Samantha — thanks for the clear ask. TL;DR: we can do a 30-day interim uplift while we finalize the private offer; invoice options are flexible (either immediate invoice for the burst or rolled into tranche 1).

Next steps I propose:
- I'm attaching our Private Offer Checklist (required fields for AWS Marketplace + how we map invoice tranches).
- Ben (Sales Ops) — can you draft a short interim-burst order (30d) with pricing bands and include an invoice timing option?
- Marissa (Legal) — any quick notes on standard acceptance language we should include for the marketplace acceptance milestone?
- Soojin (Billing) — if Helix prefers tranche billing, what's the earliest cutover we can support on our side?

Samantha — if you can confirm whether Procurement wants the burst invoiced now or appended to tranche 1, we will move the DocuSign flow and start the uplift within 48 hours once payment terms are agreed.

On attachments: PrivateOffer_Checklist_20260823.pdf attached.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mateo: +1 (628) 555-0199

Attachment: Helix_PrivateOffer_Checklist_20260823.pdf (pdf)
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>; marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-24T09:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace renewal & short-term capacity request

Mateo / team — attaching the interim-burst order draft for 30 days (flat uplift + per-token overage). Key points:
- 30-day uplift: 100K token-equivalent burst capacity, priced at the committed uplift rate (pro-rated).
- Invoice options: (A) immediate net-30 invoice for the burst OR (B) include burst as tranche 1, net-30 after tranche acceptance. If Helix chooses (B) we can lock the price but require the PO to reference the interim burst order id.
- Acceptance language: defined as acceptance of marketplace private offer + pods live for customers; Marissa, I added the typical acceptance milestone paragraph — pls redline if needed.

I pushed a minimal DocuSign envelope for the burst invoice estimate so Mateo can route to Samantha once she confirms invoice preference.

Attachments: interim-burst-order-30d.json, docusign-invoice-estimate.pdf

Thanks, Mateo / Ben — 

Helix will take the 30-day interim uplift and prefers option (B): append the burst to tranche 1 so we have a single invoice/PO footprint for accounting. Our procurement lead asks that the DocuSign envelope include a single line item for the burst referencing PO HLX-PO-202608, and that the private-offer checklist be returned with the signed PO.

Action items from our side:
- I'll route PO HLX-PO-202608 to accounts-pay and add the reference to the interim-burst order id once you provide it.
- Please send the DocuSign link for the combined tranche + interim burst and confirm acceptance milestones (we need the acceptance schedule to show tranche 1 split into two invoice events: initial invoice for 60% at activation, final invoice for 40% at 30-day acceptance).

If you can get the DocuSign today, procurement will aim to approve by Friday.

Regards,
Samantha
Head of Platform Engineering, Helix AI
